The same host-class boundary reads identically in the TL;DR, D4 (second class, and the boundary paragraph), the host row's cell, the two cost bullets, Consequences, O8 and plan steps 1, 2 and 6. I found no place where the exemption survives as an open choice, and no place where a no-object registration is put inside the class.
- Q3 A: D1 Verbs, D3, the Q3 Ruled paragraph, Consequences and plan steps 2 to 4 admit the write form in the `where` of a predicate `update` and nowhere else; `delete` keeps the refusal.
- The verbatim option text and its timestamp match the ruling record character for character. The options, costs and recommendations are kept as history, each section ends with its ruling, and no decision the ruling left open was changed. Status reads Accepted with "This record declares; it implements nothing", so the record claims nothing about code on `main`; `SharedRecordIds` does not exist on `main`, and the record calls the name provisional.

**ADR-0111 D7 note.** It adds R2's inert-grant arm with the same 422 `SHARING_NOT_ENABLED`, names the same four storage rows as ADR-0155's census (including "a driver this repository does not ship that does not declare it evaluates the leaf", which is the census row's own qualifier), keeps owner, queue and approval access, and says the arm takes effect with the plugin-sharing switch "and not before". Form matches the dated italic amendment already under the same item. Holds.

**ADR-0147 D-a note.** It restates ADR-0155 D4's recipient rule for the anchor sentence by sentence (caller and organization compared together, system context exempt, mismatch or missing anchor refused in ADR-0139 D3's envelope, nothing re-derived from `userId` or `tenantId`, the delegator's rebuilt context of D-c admitted), and says it changes neither what the anchor carries nor where it is captured. Form matches the blockquote notes ADR-0139 already carries. Holds.

**ADR-0139 notes (D1, D3, O4).** Each matches the ruling in substance: one more leaf under its own brand and the read-verbs sentence revisited for that leaf alone (③ A); a driver declaration read up front under R2 with R1 as the envelope behind it; O4 answered. Decided text is untouched and each note is dated and cites the ruling record. Not adding an `Amended` entry to ADR-0139's Status paragraph follows the precedent of the 2026-11-02 ADR-0147 notes, which also left it alone.

S1 (should-fix) — ADR-0139 is Accepted and built, and its three new notes state ADR-0155's decisions in the present tense with nothing saying they are not yet on `main`. D1: "the leaf's write form is legal in the `where` of a predicate `update`". D3: "a driver declares whether it evaluates such leaves, and the declaration is read up front". O4: ADR-0155 "lowers the share arm to its own engine-internal semi-join leaf ... with no cap, so every grant counts". On `main` the engine admits no such leaf, no such declaration exists for it, and `sharing-service.ts` still reads grants at `limit: 5000`; ruling 6895275749 records that the drop stays until the switch lands. O4 is the sharpest: its original sentence about the cap remains true, and the appended one reads as if it were fixed. The existing ADR-0147 notes carry "(Proposed)" as their marker, the 2026-11-15 Status amendment says "This amendment declares; #33696's change lands only after it merges", and this PR's own ADR-0111 note says "takes effect with ... the plugin-sharing switch ... and not before"; the three ADR-0139 notes carry no equivalent. Fix: one clause in each, saying the note records a decision that ADR-0155's execution cards build, and in O4 that the capped read stands until the plugin-sharing switch on #33787 lands.

N1 (nit) — ADR-0155 O7 keeps "None is in this record's diff, which adds this record and its index row and edits no other record" directly before "**Landed** (2026-11-17): all five". The first sentence describes the authoring diff, not this one; a reader meets two statements that look opposed.

N2 (nit) — the ADR-0139 D3 note sits at section level after the conformance bullet, yet speaks of "this bullet's envelope", and it writes "as ADR-0147 revisits it for its own" without the "(Proposed)" its sibling note two paragraphs above carries. The placement is what keeps the merge with #34565 clean, so only the wording is at issue.

S1 is the only graded finding above nit level and none is graded higher; it is open on this head and owes a delta review of its fix. N1 and N2 may ride the same edit or be left.
